trickyParts: Zod 4.3.6 accepts a .refine()d ZodObject as a discriminatedUnion member (the passing-test-handoff-needs-proof rule lives on testSchema); because a refined schema cannot take .passthrough() afterwards, every phase schema now ends in .passthrough() at its own definition and the union is built from the five schemas directly.

The pane's `legion` is the live daemon's main build (docs/solutions/legion/worker-pane-shell-gotchas.md §13), so every pre-merge proof of the CLI ran the branch's entry point `bun packages/daemon/src/cli/index.ts`; the rig's <state_dir>/bin/legion launcher re-execs the branch checkout, which is how a daemon-spawned tester pane exercised the refusal.

The rig daemon's contract gate reads the plugin manifest from its own OMP_PROFILE, so the daemon was started with OMP_PROFILE=l53rig (and PI_PROFILE, with PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR unset) and this pane's LEGION_* markers unset; the rig package's manifest was rewritten exactly as prepack.sh publishes it (omp.extensions → dist/*.js, legion.daemonApiVersion 1 from this branch's package.json), because main@origin is already at contract 2 (pi-envoy 1.23.1).

The daemon's durable JetStream consumers need the ENVOY_NOTIFICATIONS stream that the Envoy listener normally creates; the rig created it directly in its NATS (subjects notifications.>) instead of running the listener.

jj split path scoping is all-or-nothing per file: Task 1's fixture edits and Task 2's new tests share ledger.test.ts and cli/handoff.test.ts, so the edits were sequenced between the two splits; biome formatting fixes were folded into the owning commits with jj squash --into rather than a fourth commit.
